cohort: The study included 287 cases of obstetrical brachial plexopathy (OBP) evaluated for malpractice by the 2nd Specialization Board of the Council of Forensic Medicine between 2013 and 2017.
finding: The study found that OBP is not only caused by trauma, but is also associated with various comorbidities, particularly neurodevelopmental problems, highlighting the need for comprehensive medical record-keeping for better understanding and standardized evaluation of OBP.
